properties.raw_text: 水飞蓟素（silymarin）是从水飞蓟种子中萃取的黄酮类混合物
properties.chunk_id: 水飞蓟素的药动学及药物相互作用_胡帆:6
properties.data: un $^{1}$ , ZUO Xiao-cong $^{1}$(1. The Third Xiangya Hospital, Central South University, Changsha HU-NAN 410013, China;2. School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Central South University, Changsha HU-NAN 410013, China)[ABSTRACT] Silymarin is a mixture of polyphenoic fiavonoids extracted from the seeds of milk thistle. It undergoes phase I and phase II metabolism and is primarily excreted from the body by bile and urine. Silymarin can decrease the activity of CYP450 and UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) enzyme. It can also inhibit the transportation of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), OATP1B1 as well as BCRP, and affect the pharmacokinetics of several drugs in vivo. Therefore, the risk of drug-drug interaction is high. This paper reviewed the recent studies on the herb-drug interaction for silymarin.水飞蓟素（silymarin）是从水飞蓟种子中萃取的黄酮类混合物 $^{[1]}$ ，由分子式为 $C_{25}H_{22}O_{10}$ 的4种同分异构体组成，包括水飞蓟宾(silybin, silibinin)、异水飞蓟宾(isosilybin, isosilibinin)、水飞蓟宁(silidianin)和水飞蓟亭(silichristin)。
